text:
alex.k: quick brain-dump — thinking about a soft-pin decay model to reduce tiny-page churn. proposal: each page has a `pin_score` that increments on access, decays periodically, and only gets demoted when score < threshold for a sustained window. should reduce oscillation vs immediate demote.

brooke: sounds promising. how do you compute the access weight? per-request or per-token? :thinking_face:

chen: rough idea: access_weight = clamp(log(tokens+1)/log(256), 0.1, 1.0). increment pin_score by access_weight. decay factor 0.85 every 100ms tick. pseudocode:
```
for page in touched_pages:
  page.pin_score += clamp(log(req.tokens+1)/log(256), 0.1, 1.0)
periodic: page.pin_score *= 0.85
if page.pin_score < demote_threshold && stale_for > demote_window: demote(page)
```

dana: tenant fairness question — a noisy tenant doing scans could keep many pages pinned and starve others.

alex.k: agree. plan: per-tenant decayers and a global admission budget. noisy tenant consumes token-bucket for pin_credit; once exhausted new accesses get 0.1 weight.

marina: telemetry we need: `pin_score_histogram`, `demote_latency_ms`, `pages_demoted_after_window`, `tenant_pin_credit_usage`. also track churn delta pre/post rollout.

chen: edge-case: long sequential scans (streaming) will still bump pin_score. add a streaming detector: if page touched once and not reused within short window, mark as stream and apply lower weight for next N pages.

brooke: nice. also: add an opt-in API hint for higher-level code: `buf.soft_pin_hint(level=1|2|3)` so model runners can indicate ephemeral hotspots.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary config created: `softpin.decay=0.85`, `softpin.threshold=2.5`, `softpin.demote_window_ms=2000`, rollout=10% tenants.

alex.k: rollout plan: canary on dedicated infra for 1 week, then 25% tenants for 2 weeks, monitor churn/latency. quick rollback knobs: set decay=0 (immediate demote) or disable softpin flag.

dana: I'll draft an RFC addendum with config names, metrics, and a short test plan (microbench + synthetic streaming). assign to me.

alex.k: :thumbsup: assigned to @dana. thanks all, will link the draft once it's up.

infra-bot: task created: ENG-PLATFORM-4321 "soft-pin decay + demote ratchet RFC addendum" assigned->dana.
